items.a: Two things. A Course of 26 videos that teaches you how to protect every part of your work on paper, and a library of 20 ready agreements covering every person you will ever deal with in this business. Clients, contractors, vendors, the freelancers you hire, and your own team. Each agreement comes with the blanks marked out for you and 55 clean Canva layouts (5 each contract) so you can send it out looking like a real brand.

items.q: I Have Never Used a Contract Before. Will I Understand It?
items.a: Yes. It starts from nothing and assumes you know no law at all. The whole 2nd module is the legal side in plain language, no jargon thrown at you, so you know exactly what is real and what is just a formality everybody stresses about for no reason. It works whether this is your 1st project or your 100th.

items.q: My Contractor Will Never Sign Anything. So What Is the Point of Contractor Agreements for Me?
items.a:
This is the most asked question, and it gets a full module of its own. A large part of our Industry is unorganised, and your kadia or your local one man contractor is genuinely never going to sign a printed document. That is normal, and anybody who tells you otherwise has never run a site in this country. So the Course gives you a whole ladder instead:
- A method for the organised people.
- A method for the semi organised ones.
- A method that never uses the word contract.

You are protected regardless of who is standing in front of you, be it a completely unorganized person or an organized person. The rule the whole Course stands on is that it is never ZERO. The method changes completely depending on who is in front of you. It is just never nothing.

items.q: Are These Actually Legal in India? Do I Need Stamp Paper or a Notary?
items.a: The contracts are lawyer verified and built for Indian practice. And the stamp paper, notary, registration related doubts gets cleared completely in the Course. Your design contract is valid and binding without stamp paper. Stamping is a small flat state fee, nothing else, and it is what makes a contract ready to be used in court, not what makes it real. Your service agreements do not need to be registered, and notarisation is optional, never required.

items.q: Do I Need to Buy Any Software?
items.a: No. It runs on free tools only. The contracts open in Notion, the Designed layouts are in Canva, and the 3 trackers are Notion, all on Free plans.

items.q: Will It Work for a Small Job, Like One Room Worth ₹40,000?
items.a: Yes, and the Course is very specific about this. You never put a 20 page contract in front of a ₹40,000 job, that just frightens a perfectly good client away. You right size the paper to the job, and you are taught exactly how to judge that, by the money, the risk, and how long the relationship will last.

Straight after payment. You are taken to your dashboard with everything inside it, and you also get an order confirmation email with your access within 5 to 10 minutes. Check spam if you do not see it. Log in with the email or phone number you paid with and start.

items.q: What Is the Difference Between the 3 Plans?
items.a:
The contracts are the only thing that changes between the First 2 plans, and both of them come with 5 designed Canva layouts for every contract you get. The 3rd plan is the one that also gives you the COURSE.

1. "Design Studio Contracts" gives you the 9 contracts you sign when you design and somebody else builds: Design-Only, Consultancy, Client Confirmation Document, Freelancer, 3D Render, CAD Drafting, Employment, Partnership and Joint Venture.
2. "Site & Execution Contracts" gives you the 11 contracts you sign the moment you take responsibility for building: Turnkey, Civil, Electrical, Plumbing, Flooring, False Ceiling, Carpentry, Modular Kitchen & Wardrobe, Painting, Full Execution and Vendor. It also carries the 45 site annexures, 5 behind each of the 9 contractor agreements, which are the material specification sheet, the hold point checklist, the snag list and the defect log, the drawing register.
3. "All Contracts + Course" gives you all 20 contracts, the 45 annexures, and the full 26-video Course that teaches you how to use every single one of them. It also carries the 3 Studio Trackers and every future update, free forever.

So pick by the work you actually do. If you only design, take "Design Studio" 1st Plan. If you design and build, take "Site & Execution" 2nd Plan. And if you want somebody to actually teach you which contract to pull out, what is safe to change, and how to put it in front of a person without scaring them off, that only comes with "All Contracts + Course" 3rd Plan. The documents are the easy part and that is why most designers take the 3rd one.

items.q: Why Not Just Download a Free Contract Template From the Internet?
items.a: Because a free contract is a document somebody generated from AI, which doesn't know shit about running an Interior design or Architecture business in India. You do not know who wrote it, whether they have ever run a project here, or why a single clause is in there. So you send it, it either scares the client off or protects nothing, and the moment something actually goes wrong you find out the hard way which parts were useless. What I'm giving you is not a pile of documents. It is the whole system, built and used on 110+ real projects, with the Course that makes it work, the exact way to hand it over so people say yes, and a way to get even the ones who never sign onto record. I know exactly what I have made and I am very confident about what it does for you. If it does not do it, you get your money back. As simple as that.
